Hey, folks! This mod simply edits the dresser included in [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/331/?]Get Dressed[/url] to be a bit more rustic, with a sturdier design. It is now a darker wood and includes a chicken painting!

Is there no mirror anymore, or did you become a chicken and the dresser is actually showing your reflection? I guess we'll never know.

To install, make a backup of your files and unzip the [font=Courier New]Content [/font]folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley[/font] folder, overwriting everything. If you're using Steam, the location should be[font=Courier New] "Steam\steamapps\Stardew Valley".

[/font]Enjoy!
